title: JazzDeviceBundleV2FlattenedJWS
description: Flattened JWS JSON serialization of one canonical JazzDeviceBundleV2Payload. Only protected, payload and signature are allowed: an unprotected header, embedded key material or key-retrieval URL is never part of this trust boundary. The decoded protected object is exactly {alg: EdDSA, kid, typ: application/jazz-device-bundle+jws}; semantic checks are enforced by the verifier.

signature.description: Unpadded base64url of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
